description.value: Tyndall Stone Lodge is a 12-unit condo complex in Whistler Village North managed by Whiski Jack Resorts, offering two-bedroom and two-bedroom plus loft suites with fully equipped kitchens and powerful air conditioning. Located adjacent to Olympic Plaza and steps from Whistler's world-class restaurants and nightlife, it serves as a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area's renowned mountain biking trails. The free Village shuttle stops nearby, putting both the Whistler and Blackcomb lift bases within easy reach.
